## Summary / خلاصه

What does this change improve? / این تغییر چه مشکلی را حل می‌کند؟

## Tests / تست‌ها

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Windows smoke test (if UI, packaging or downloads changed)
- [ ] Upgrade and rollback test (if installer code changed)

## Privacy / حریم خصوصی

- [ ] No secrets, user media, private boards or cookies are included.

## Evidence / شواهد

Add screenshots of actual UI **only** if relevant, with personal data removed.
